deviations.what: Live t9 run found that sloth export's --adapter/--output/--calib path sanitizer (_sanitize_path, export.py:246-273, landed in the #20 squash after its live validation) also runs INSIDE the container, where cwd is /workspace and HOME is the export home, so every real export exits 1 with 'path is outside the allowed roots' for the identity-mounted host path. Every export on main is broken. Proposed fix (not in any plan task): _container_kwargs forwards SLOTH_ALLOWED_ROOTS into the container env, set to the identity-mounted parents (adapter, output, calib, dataset), plus a unit test asserting the env reaches the docker argv and a fake in-container request under /workspace passes the sanitizer.
deviations.reason: blocking: t9's export rows (c10, c12, c21) cannot run until real exports work again
